name: Materials and Prototyping
description: The students would understand material selection and get hands-on exposure to the digital fabrication based prototyping techniques such as additive manufacturing, computer controlled cutting and machining, molding and casting, microcontroller programming, input devices including sensors, output devices including actuators, networking and communication with Bluetooth and Wi-Fi modules. The students would also work on a course project assimilating the skills learnt in the class. This course should enable the students to gain the confidence to translate their ideas to build almost any electro-mechanical functional prototype.
